name: Iris
description: The incoming clip appears in a circle that grows from a point until it covers the whole frame, with a soft edge.

params.label: Centre
params.description: Where the circle opens, as a share of the frame's width and height: 0.5, 0.5 is the middle, 0, 0 the top left corner.

params.label: Softness
params.description: Width of the circle's soft edge as a share of the frame's longer side; 0 gives a hard edge.

author: Example Author
